name: Wang Liang Master (Wang Liang Monk 6)
source: Wang Liang Master from the Tome of Horrors Complete
book: Wang Liang Master from the Tome of Horrors Complete

facets.bk: Wang Liang Master from the Tome of Horrors Complete

body:
This feral humanoid creature is completely hairless with gray skin. Its eyes are pools of midnight with glittering red ruby dots that serve as pupils and shine with a hellish glow. Its hands end in razor-sharpened talons that have the appearance and color of iron. Its mouth is lined with rows of shark-like teeth and its ears are pointed.

Wang Liang Master
CR 8

XP 4,800
Wang liang monk 6
LE Medium outsider (evil, extraplanar, lawful)
Init +8; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +17

DEFENSE

AC 24, touch 21, flat-footed 19 (+4 Dex, +1 deflection, +1 Dodge, +1 monk, +3 natural, +4 Wis)
hp 75 (4d10+8 plus 6d8+12 plus 6); fast healing 2
Fort +8, Ref +13, Will +13; +2 vs. enchantment
Defensive Abilities evasion, maneuver training, still mind; DR 5/silver; Immune disease, poison; Resist fire 5

OFFENSE

Speed 50 ft.
Melee bite +12 (1d6+2 plus poison), 2 claws +12 (1d4+2 plus poison), or unarmed strike +12/+7 (1d8+2), or +1 kama +14/+9 (1d6+3), or unarmed flurry of blows +12/+12/+7 (1d8+2), or kama flurry of blows +1 kama +14/+14/+9 (1d6+3)
Special Attacks flurry of blows, poison, Stunning Fist (fatigued, DC 17)
Spell-like Abilities (CL 4th):

At will—detect good
3/day—curse water (DC 11), darkness

STATISTICS

Str 14, Dex 19, Con 15, Int 10, Wis 18, Cha 10
Base Atk +8; CMB +16; CMD 31
Feats Combat ReflexesB, DodgeB, Improved DisarmB, Improved Initiative, Improved Unarmed StrikeB, Mobility, Power Attack, Stunning FistB, Weapon Finesse, Weapon Focus (kama)
Skills Acrobatics +13 (+19 jumping), Bluff +8, Climb +9, Intimidate +6, Knowledge (planes) +5, Perception +17, Sense Motive +17, Stealth +13, Survival +10
Languages Common, Infernal
SQ fast movement, high jump, ki pool (7 points, magic), purity of body, slow fall (30 ft.)
Combat Gear potion of haste; Other Gear +1 kama, ring of protection +1

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Poison (Ex)

Bite, Claw–injury; save Fort DC 17; frequency 1/round for 2 rounds; effect 1d4 Str; cure 1 save. The save DC is Constitution-based.
